summary: hwi-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH/AWS/npm credentials and wallet material to pipedream webhook
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall.js lifecycle script reads a fixed list of installer-owned secret files (~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.npmrc, ~/.env, Solana/Ethereum key material) and additionally walks dotdirectories under $HOME collecting any file whose name matches /wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private/i or *.json. The collected contents are POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded endpoint enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net. The package presents itself as a Hardware Wallet Interface but its only install-time behavior is credential and wallet-seed exfiltration to an attacker-controlled webhook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
